designs.name: 卷光晨曦
designs.inherit: V2-01 卷芽额毛与暖金眼
designs.halo: 一圈暖白自发光细环，前缘一小缕光卷；没有实体边框。
designs.wing: 圆短奶白羽翼，最外侧一束羽尖轻轻回卷。
designs.motion: 抬头时额毛与环边小卷形成呼应；羽尖随着收翅轻轻回弹。
designs.watch: 光卷不变成第二个环；卷羽不长成触手。
designs.spec:
ID CURLLIGHT. Apricot-cream kitten with the beloved single thick curled sprout forelock above forehead, broad peachy cheeks, enlarged honey-gold irises with black oval pupils, green bib, compact fluffy body. NO oversized ears. HALO is a horizontal circular line of PURE warm WHITE LIGHT surrounded by pale amber bloom; ONE small curl of light rises at front. It has NO material, NO metal, NO wire, NO reflective surface. Hair curl remains real fur, halo curl is only emitted light. Labels LIGHT CURL / EMISSIVE HALO.
WINGS: small rounded ivory feather wings, outermost short feather bundle on each wing curls gently upward into a soft comma, all other feathers normal; not rigid flat slabs. The signature is CURL pairing forehead/halo/wing tips, modest and elegant. Right panel enlarged curl-rim halo and curled tip feather wing; labels "ONE CURL ON RIM", "SOFT CURLED FEATHER TIP", "HONEY GOLD IRIS", "SPROUT FORELOCK".
designs.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Generate a NEW wide 1536x1024 or larger original character design sheet, premium live-action fantasy creature look: realistic individual fur and soft studio daylight, deliberately cute slightly exaggerated cat proportions, rounded eyes and soft volume. Not ordinary breed photography; not plastic toy, anime or flat cartoon. Optimistic warmhearted angel kitten, stays feline, four paws, no human hands/teeth/standing person.
Layout LEFT two thirds: EIGHT full-body turnaround views in aligned 2x4 grid of exactly SAME individual. Upper DAILY row completely wingless. Lower ANGEL row same kitten with ONE pair of designed wings. Columns FRONT, strict PROFILE L nose left, BACK, strict PROFILE R nose right. Consistent identity, shape, accessory placement, iris color, body scale in all eight images. Natural quadruped standing, no seated profiles, all paws visible, full tail and halo not cropped. Halo ALWAYS above head in both forms. Wingless back has no wing stubs.
RIGHT third: professional detail column, FOUR clear labeled close-ups: FACE (include iris color annotation and visible black pupil), HALO (full enlarged ring design), WING (full enlarged one wing showing texture and unique shape), SIGNATURE (original approved cat feature, e.g. curl/body/tail/cheeks). Short readable English descriptions and fine arrows. Layout must leave room for 8 views and actual close-up art, no repetitive prose filler.
Warm ivory plain studio background, refined understated design-sheet typography and subtle panel rules. Halo and wing differences must be CLEARLY visible in turnarounds and magnifications, not merely written in text. Wings have tactile realistic ivory feather material except specified edge colors. Halo must still read as a floating angel ring with visible central opening. No giant religious regalia, no extra arms, no huge wings hiding cat. No new superpowers depicted. Keep all color markings consistent. Use sparse typography and no extra story illustrations.
CRITICAL USER CORRECTION, overrides ALL earlier material words and labels: this is the Western angelic HALO, made ONLY OF SELF-EMITTED LIGHT, not a gold headband, metal hoop, crown, solid ribbon or jewelry. Every full-body view and halo close-up MUST show a bright warm-white luminous core, a soft translucent golden bloom, airy edges and subtle warm light spilling on the kitten's ear fur. No metallic shading, no hard material thickness, no dark gold side surface, no solid texture. Keep the background behind halo slightly mid-gray so radiant halo reads clearly. Any decorative curl, heart, bow, star is ONLY LIGHT, never an attached material charm. Write only matching LIGHT-related labels, omit all outdated metal/satin/ribbon descriptions.

designs.name: 暖心胖橘
designs.inherit: V2-03 梨形胖橘与小圆爪
designs.halo: 暖白光环前缘汇成小小心形光结，仍是通透的光。
designs.wing: 两只短圆羽翼从背后展开时，外轮廓合成柔软的心形。
designs.motion: 跑到求助者身边后小幅张翅，像准备拥抱；重点仍是猫的动作。
designs.watch: 心形来自双翼组合轮廓，不把翅膀变成两个塑料爱心。
designs.spec:
ID HEARTPEAR. Cute round plump pear-shaped orange-white kitten, caramel iris and large black oval pupils, small normal cat ears, white muzzle/chest/paws, pale blue bib, normal usable quadruped legs visible under round torso. Keep charming chubby orange body. HALO is a thin horizontal ring of PURE warm WHITE RADIANCE, with a tiny luminous HEART-SHAPED light loop on front rim, diffuse golden aura. No physical heart charm, no metallic rim, no necklace. Label HEART OF LIGHT.
WINGS: ivory layered round feathers; pair has two rounded upper lobes and tapered lower inner edges, so BACK VIEW spread pair outlines a SOFT HEART across upper back. Each wing must remain an articulated feather wing, not a solid heart prop. Right enlarged halo heart-knot plus back-view paired-wing silhouette inset, labels "TINY OPEN HEART KNOT", "PAIRED HEART SILHOUETTE", "CARAMEL IRIS", "SOFT PEAR BODY".

designs.name: 可可光结
designs.inherit: V2-04 巧克力配色、奶白眉点与粗绒尾
designs.halo: 两缕淡金白光交叠成环，猫左侧形成轻巧蝴蝶形光结。
designs.wing: 奶白短羽翼，外缘少量羽尖呈可可棕，呼应身体配色。
designs.motion: 歪头时小光结跟着偏一下；收翼时可可色羽尖形成小色块。
designs.watch: 蝴蝶结固定在环的猫左侧；可可色只占羽尖，保留白色天使翼识别。

designs.name: 云光抱抱
designs.inherit: V2-05 三瓣云朵腮毛与水蓝眼
designs.halo: 柔雾状乳白光构成中空光环，边缘轻轻起伏，前方一点暖光。
designs.wing: 小巧圆润的分层绒羽，羽缘像叠起的云瓣，与腮毛呼应。
designs.motion: 侧头倾听时腮毛轻晃；翅膀收起成软软的小团，只在有翼状态出现。
designs.watch: 云环仍需清晰中空，不做成头顶一坨云；羽翼有羽毛层次，不是棉花球。
designs.spec:

designs.name: 歪环小星
designs.inherit: V2-01 卷毛脸型；保留偏圆、好奇的乐天派神态
designs.halo: 略微倾斜的暖白光环，低处漂浮一颗星形微光，无吊链。
designs.wing: 奶白羽翼末端各有一枚浅金羽，形成克制的标记。
designs.motion: 停步时小星星轻摆，光环可以短暂歪一下；不用每个镜头持续晃动。
designs.watch: 星星只一颗、位置固定；倾斜是姿态提案，不能使环穿进头或耳朵。
designs.spec:

Label TILTED LIGHT / STAR SPARK.

Detail halo close-up shows tilt and single hanging star, wing close-up clearly golden terminal feather. Labels "GENTLY TILTED RING", "ONE DANGLING STAR", "ONE GOLD TIP FEATHER", "AMBER IRIS", "CURL FORELOCK".
